mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.payment_order_id, r.payment_channel_suborder_id, r.channel_out_refund_no, r.channel_out_trade_no, r.channel_transaction_id, r.refund_amount_fen, p.channel_app_id, p.channel_mch_id, s.sub_mchid_snapshot, s.channel_suborder_amount_fen FROM refund_order r JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=r.payment_order_id JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.id=r.payment_channel_suborder_id AND s.payment_order_id=p.id WHERE r.channel_out_refund_no=#{no}
mapper.sql: r.id, r.refund_no, r.request_idempotency_key, r.biz_order_type, r.biz_order_id, r.rental_order_id, r.payment_order_id, r.payment_channel_suborder_id, r.refund_type, r.refund_status, r.channel_transaction_id, r.channel_out_trade_no, r.channel_out_refund_no, r.channel_refund_no, r.custom_goods_refund_amount_fen, r.rent_refund_amount_fen, r.deposit_refund_amount_fen, r.freight_refund_amount_fen, r.refund_amount_fen, r.refund_reason, r.requested_by, r.requested_at, r.success_at, r.failed_at, r.fail_reason, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.next_attempt_at, r.last_checked_at, r.attempt_count, r.last_error_code, r.version
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rent_refund_amount_fen), 0) rent_fen, COALESCE(SUM(deposit_refund_amount_fen), 0) deposit_fen, COALESCE(SUM(freight_refund_amount_fen), 0) freight_fen, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount_fen), 0) total_fen FROM refund_order WHERE payment_channel_suborder_id=#{id} AND refund_status!='cancelled'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_order(id, refund_no, request_idempotency_key, biz_order_type, biz_order_id, rental_order_id, payment_order_id, payment_channel_suborder_id, refund_type, refund_status, pay_channel, channel_transaction_id, channel_out_trade_no, channel_out_refund_no, rent_refund_amount_fen, deposit_refund_amount_fen, service_fee_refund_fen, freight_refund_amount_fen, compensation_refund_amount_fen, custom_goods_refund_amount_fen, refund_amount_fen, refund_reason, requested_by, requested_at, created_at, updated_at, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{refund.id}, #{refund.refundNo}, #{refund.requestIdempotencyKey}, #{refund.bizOrderType}, #{refund.bizOrderId}, #{refund.rentalOrderId}, #{refund.paymentOrderId}, #{refund.paymentChannelSuborderId}, #{refund.refundType}, 'pending', 'wechat_pay', #{refund.channelTransactionId}, #{refund.channelOutTradeNo}, #{refund.channelOutRefundNo}, #{refund.rentRefundAmountFen}, #{refund.depositRefundAmountFen}, 0, #{refund.freightRefundAmountFen}, 0, 0, #{refund.refundAmountFen}, #{refund.refundReason}, #{refund.requestedBy}, #{refund.requestedAt}, #{refund.createdAt}, #{refund.updatedAt}, #{refund.nextAttemptAt})

mapper.update: UPDATE refund_order SET next_attempt_at=#{attempt.next}, last_checked_at=#{attempt.now}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, version=version+1, updated_at=#{attempt.now} WHERE id=#{attempt.id} AND version=#{attempt.version} AND refund_status NOT IN ('success', 'cancelled') AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at<=#{attempt.now})

UPDATE refund_order SET next_attempt_at=#{finish.next}, last_error_code=#{finish.errorCode}, updated_at=#{finish.now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{finish.id} AND version=#{finish.version} AND refund_status NOT IN ('success', 'cancelled')

UPDATE refund_order SET refund_status=#{fact.status}, channel_refund_no=#{fact.channelRefundNo}, success_at=#{fact.successAt}, failed_at=CASE WHEN #{fact.status}='failed' THEN #{fact.now} ELSE NULL END, fail_reason=#{fact.error}, last_error_code=#{fact.error}, last_checked_at=#{fact.now}, next_attempt_at=#{fact.next}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{fact.now} WHERE id=#{fact.id} AND refund_status NOT IN ('success', 'cancelled')

UPDATE payment_channel_suborder s JOIN ( SELECT payment_channel_suborder_id, SUM(refund_amount_fen) amount FROM refund_order WHERE payment_channel_suborder_id=#{id} AND refund_status='success' GROUP BY payment_channel_suborder_id) r ON r.payment_channel_suborder_id=s.id SET s.refunded_amount_fen=r.amount, s.channel_suborder_status=CASE WHEN r.amount=s.paid_amount_fen THEN 'fully_refunded' ELSE 'partially_refunded' END, s.version=s.version+1, s.updated_at=#{now} WHERE s.id=#{id} AND r.amount<=s.paid_amount_fen

UPDATE payment_order p JOIN ( SELECT payment_order_id, SUM(refunded_amount_fen) amount FROM payment_channel_suborder WHERE payment_order_id=#{id} GROUP BY payment_order_id) s ON s.payment_order_id=p.id SET p.refunded_amount_fen=s.amount, p.version=p.version+1, p.updated_at=#{now} WHERE p.id=#{id} AND s.amount<=p.paid_amount_fen

UPDATE rental_order o JOIN ( SELECT rental_order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_status='success' THEN rent_refund_amount_fen ELSE 0 END) rent, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_status='success' THEN deposit_refund_amount_fen ELSE 0 END) deposit, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_status='success' THEN freight_refund_amount_fen ELSE 0 END) freight, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_status='success' THEN refund_amount_fen ELSE 0 END) total, SUM(refund_status IN ('pending', 'processing')) pending, SUM(refund_status='failed') failed, SUM(deposit_refund_amount_fen>0 AND refund_status IN ('pending','processing','failed')) deposit_pending FROM refund_order WHERE rental_order_id=#{id} GROUP BY rental_order_id) r ON r.rental_order_id=o.id SET o.rent_refunded_amount_fen=r.rent, o.deposit_refunded_amount_fen=r.deposit, o.freight_refunded_amount_fen=r.freight, o.total_refunded_amount_fen=r.total, o.refund_status=CASE WHEN r.total=o.total_paid_amount_fen THEN 'full_refunded' WHEN r.pending>0 THEN 'processing' WHEN r.failed>0 THEN 'failed' WHEN r.total>0 THEN 'partial_refunded' ELSE 'none' END, o.deposit_status=CASE WHEN o.deposit_paid_amount_fen=0 THEN 'settled' WHEN r.deposit=o.deposit_paid_amount_fen THEN 'refunded' WHEN r.deposit_pending>0 THEN 'refunding' WHEN r.deposit+o.deposit_deducted_amount_fen=o.deposit_paid_amount_fen THEN 'settled' ELSE o.deposit_status END, o.version=o.version+1, o.updated_at=#{now} WHERE o.id=#{id} AND r.rent<=o.rent_paid_amount_fen-o.rent_deducted_amount_fen AND r.deposit<=o.deposit_paid_amount_fen-o.deposit_deducted_amount_fen AND r.freight<=o.freight_prepaid_paid_amount_fen

UPDATE rental_order_freight_account f JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=f.rental_order_id SET f.refunded_amount_fen=o.freight_refunded_amount_fen, f.refundable_amount_fen=f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen-f.online_settle_amount_fen-o.freight_refunded_amount_fen, f.freight_status=CASE WHEN f.freight_status='cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' WHEN o.freight_refunded_amount_fen+f.online_settle_amount_fen=f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen AND o.order_status IN ('manual_rejected','timeout_rejected','user_cancelled','cancelled') THEN 'cancelled' WHEN o.freight_refunded_amount_fen+f.online_settle_amount_fen=f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen AND (f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen>0 OR f.freight_status IN ('refunding','refundable','settled')) THEN 'settled' ELSE f.freight_status END, f.settled_at=CASE WHEN f.freight_status='cancelled' THEN f.settled_at WHEN o.freight_refunded_amount_fen+f.online_settle_amount_fen=f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen AND (f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen>0 OR f.freight_status IN ('refunding','refundable','settled')) THEN COALESCE(f.settled_at,#{now}) ELSE f.settled_at END, f.version=f.version+1, f.updated_at=#{now} WHERE f.rental_order_id=#{id} AND o.freight_refunded_amount_fen+f.online_settle_amount_fen<=f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen
